title: Mental Floss Article on Paleoart
content: The news magazine Mental Flossjust posted an articleabout bringing dinosaurs back to life, tracing the journey from fossils to oil paintings.----"How Paleoartists Recreate and Illustrate Dinosaurs"by Gabe RivinOrder the 40-minute full-length tutorial video "Tyrannosaurs: Behind the Art" atGumroad(credit cards) orSellfy(Paypal).
